name: Michael Joyce
bio:
* World class experience applying Lean and agile tools and attitudes
* Highly skills in the areas of Agile Software Development, Devops, Data, Security, and Product.
* Enjoyed working with companies in several industries including Networks and Telecommunications, Primary Industries, Banking, Health, Retail, Data, and Media
* Created, lead and mentored teams, especially Agile methodologies and the importance of culture
* Extremely adaptable and able to build trust, gain stakeholder confidence and deliver change outcomes
